description: Joins the plans Tewip wrote for a project to the tests that cover them and the runs that attempted them. A scenario counts as covered only when a real test can be named, and as passing only when a real run attempted it; everything else is reported as never run or not covered. Use for "are we ready to release?" and "what is not tested?".

only.description: Only plans whose title, ticket or feature contains this

project.description: Absolute path of the project folder

name: trace_requirements
title: Is this requirement covered, and is it passing?
